description: Election bodies: what the site needs to know about a body it files elections under (its elections are in data/elections-source/data/elections/<id>/), kept as data so a new body is added here rather than in each builder and view. A body listed here is read from here first; the bodies not yet listed are still described by the lists in the code that predate this registry (scripts/build/build-test2-election-manifest.mjs resolveElectionGeography and votingSystemForElection, scripts/lib/election-names.mjs, packages/map/src/app/helpers.mjs, src/catalogue/view-elections.js and search.js, scripts/build/build-browse-indexes.mjs, scripts/build/build-party-profiles.mjs, scripts/build/catalogue/build-catalogue.mjs). Fields: name (the body as elections_index.json names it); jurisdiction; typeLabel (the kind of election, as the map app labels a candidacy); shortLabel and shelf (the catalogue's Elections rows and shelves, src/catalogue/view-elections.js BODY_GROUPS ids); searchTerms (catalogue search); title and wikipediaTitle ({year} is the election's year); wholeArea (every election of the body covers its whole area, so none is a by-election); votingSystem, and contestVotingSystems for the contests counted otherwise (by the contest's name); byElectionTitle and byElectionsTitle (a by-election's title where `title` names the general elections; {contest} is the contest); partyGroup (the party profiles' chart, scripts/build/build-party-profiles.mjs); geography (the map its elections are drawn on, by date, with the feature a result names where the names differ); areaResults (a national contest's figures broken down by the areas it was counted in, filed in `dir`/<date>/: shown as a second geography of the one election, never as candidacies). Schema: packages/registries/schemas/election-bodies.schema.json; views: packages/registries/src/election-bodies.mjs.

contestVotingSystems.note: The university constituencies are counted by the Dail's rules, whole ballot papers drawn from the last parcel (Seanad Electoral (University Members) Act 1937); the vocational panels value each paper at 1,000 and transfer fractions of it (Seanad Electoral (Panel Members) Act 1947, Second Schedule).

groups.description: How the site groups the bodies, each list in its display order. A body is placed by the first group whose `match` it meets: `bodies` (its slug is one of these), `prefixes` (its slug starts with one), `contains` (its slug contains one), or `pattern` (a regular expression, case-insensitive). catalogueShelves: the catalogue's Elections shelves (packages/map/src/catalogue/view-elections.js BODY_GROUPS); a body listed above with a `shelf` joins that shelf, and `councilFlag` adds the councils of the councils registry with that flag. partyCharts: the bodies a party profile charts (scripts/build/build-party-profiles.mjs), matched on the election key's body; a body listed above with a `partyGroup` gets a chart of its own after these. catalogueOrder: the order of the catalogue's body list (scripts/build/catalogue/build-catalogue.mjs); a body not listed follows, alphabetically. electionsHome: the Elections app's home page (site/apps/elections/views/home.js), matched on the body slug, shown in `order`. entityHistory: the groups of a person's or party's election history in the map app (packages/map/src/entity-detail-data.mjs), matched on the election's type label.
